title: Forging More Tasks into Better Harnesses: Agentic Harness Evolution via Successive Scale Racing
abstract: arXiv:2610.28815v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic harness evolution optimizes an agent's instructions, tools, and control flow by using its task execution experiences as evolving evidence. While more evolution tasks should intuitively improve performance, our preliminary study reveals a paradoxical failure mode: the performance of existing methods degrades as the task pool expands. Our further analysis demonstrates that this degradation stems from suboptimal evidence selection during optimization, as different evidence combinations lead to substantially different evolution outcomes. To address this issue, we propose Successive Scale Racing (SSR), a framework that adaptively searches for optimal evidence combinations in each evolution round. SSR constructs diverse evidence combinations based on the corresponding task quality and coverage, and efficiently races the resulting candidate harnesses under a small compute budget. tldr: 提出了逐级规模竞赛框架，在每个演化轮次中根据任务质量与覆盖度自适应搜索最优证据组合，并以小计算预算对候选框架进行竞赛，从而解决了任务池扩大反而导致智能体框架演化性能下降的矛盾问题。
en_tdlr: It proposes Successive Scale Racing (SSR), a framework that adaptively searches for optimal evidence combinations in each evolution round—constructing diverse combinations based on task quality and coverage and racing candidate harnesses under a small compute budget—to resolve the paradoxical performance degradation of agentic harness evolution as the task pool expands.
